observations.name: media canonical owner containment single
observations.review: Express decoding plus decodeURIComponent and substring owner matching occur before path.join normalizes dot segments. A path containing the caller ownership substring can normalize to a different user file.
observations.impactLimit: Exact synthetic foreign message/avatar files are deleted after independently verified existence. Outside-upload arbitrary filesystem deletion and real Cloudinary cross-user destruction are not demonstrated.

observations.name: SDK resource type octet PDF
observations.review: The router admits supported octet-stream suffixes, but the controller chooses raw/video/image solely from MIME. Accepted octet-PDF/MP4 therefore defaults to image.
observations.impactLimit: Octet-PDF is stored image/pdf instead of raw; octet-MP4 receives provider400 and application500 with no asset. The cause is application dispatch, not a provider outage.

observations.name: SDK resource type octet video
observations.review: The router admits supported octet-stream suffixes, but the controller chooses raw/video/image solely from MIME. Accepted octet-PDF/MP4 therefore defaults to image.
observations.impactLimit: Octet-PDF is stored image/pdf instead of raw; octet-MP4 receives provider400 and application500 with no asset. The cause is application dispatch, not a provider outage.

observations.name: SDK explicit overwrite prevention
observations.review: unique_filename:true and generated IDs exist, but overwrite:false is omitted. Real provider controls establish explicit false preserves bytes and true replaces them; no application collision occurred.
observations.impactLimit: Policy/defense in depth, not demonstrated overwrite vulnerability.

observations.name: SDK prototype-like context denied before upload
observations.review: folderMap[context] accepts inherited properties; constructor selects a function instead of a folder string. The SDK double rejects and application500 is recorded.
observations.impactLimit: Input reliability and future namespace hardening.

observations.name: SDK owner video delete operation
observations.review: deleteFile tries image then raw and never video. A stored video remains while the controller reports404.
observations.impactLimit: Offline call intent and real TEST video retention reproduce; independent typed deletion succeeds, so provider deletion support is established.

observations.name: SDK deletion requests CDN invalidation
observations.review: Application destroy omits invalidate:true. Cached video bytes remain200 after exact origin absence; raw/image delivery changed to404 in the fresh run with unchanged source.
observations.impactLimit: Conditional confidentiality/deletion policy; CI proves bounded origin/cache observations, not global revocation.

observations.name: SDK delete rejects namespace containing embedded owner
observations.review: The embedded caller substring passes ownsFile without exact approved application root/typed asset identity; the double records two destroys even though the ID is unregistered.
observations.impactLimit: Authorization hardening based on call intent; no live provider IDOR claim.

observations.name: SDK success then URL failure compensates upload
observations.review: Generic catch returns500 after successful upload but performs no compensating destroy. The SDK-double inventory contains a new orphan.
observations.impactLimit: Lifecycle/reliability hardening with simulated failure injection, not a newly executed provider orphan exploit.

observations.name: SDK video upload to message compatibility

observations.impactLimit: Authorized real message route returns400 after a successful video upload in the focused offline lane. Real released-device playback remains untested.
